title: phyteuma corniculatum subsp. scheuchzeri
intro: Phyteuma corniculatum subsp. scheuchzeri, commonly known as Alpine Ragwort or Scheuchzer's Toothwort, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the bellflower family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues and digestive problems, due to its health benefits such as expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Phyteuma corniculatum subsp. scheuchzeri include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve coughs and congestion, as well as an anti-inflammatory, reducing swelling and pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, terpenoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
